newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish firms show Q1 PLN 2.5 bln net profit.
newsitem.headline: Polish firms show Q1 PLN 2.5 bln net profit.

text.p: Polish enterprises reported an overall 2.5 billion zloty net profit in the January-March period, compared with a 2.4 billion zloty net profit in the same period of 1996, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
GUS said the private sector had a net profit of 1.1 billion zlotys on total revenues of 71.3 billion in the period against a profit of 1.4 billion and sales of 63.6 in the same period last year.
The state-owned sector reported a profit of 1.4 billion on sales of 75.4 billion versus last year's 1.0 billion and 53.5 billion respectively.
NOTES: Data collected from all companies employing more than 50 people in main sectors of the economy.
Liquidity ratio is a percentage relation of cash reserves and tradable securities to short-term liabilities.
